description: Stop generated report/receipt/certificate PDFs from ever serving a stale CDN (or browser) copy after regeneration. Root cause: generated PDFs are written to a FIXED, timestamp-free R2 key (keyForYear(year,'pdf',pdfName,docType) => 2026/pdf/report_en/Chhath-Puja-Report-2026.pdf), so re-generating OVERWRITES the same object at the same public URL; Cloudflare's CDN then serves the previously cached bytes for up to 4h (observed cf-cache-status: HIT, age, cache-control: max-age=14400). That is why the English Annual Report still shows blank to the user even though the server-side PDF is now correct: English was cached blank BEFORE the #400 data fix, while Hindi/Both were generated for the first time only after it. Fix by adopting the codebase's OWN established precedent (keyForUserPhoto/keyForDonationQr embed Date.now() so 'a stale CDN copy is never served after a re-upload'): make each generated-PDF (re)generation a DISTINCT object key so the URL changes and no stale CDN/browser copy can ever be served. Additionally set a short revalidating Cache-Control on generated PDF objects via putToR2 as defense in depth. Delete the previous R2 object on regeneration so distinct keys do not leak R2 storage unboundedly. generated_files.public_link/drive_path are rewritten to the NEW key by the existing recordGeneratedFile UPSERT, so the public portal 'Verified Record' links and the R2->Drive move (storage.js moveOneUrl -> keyFromR2Url) stay consistent. This is a single coherent backend change touching r2.js + docxTemplates.js; it applies to ALL PDF generation paths (reports, receipts, certificates, samaan, consent, auto-generate-on-save) because all three R2 write sites share the same key builder and putToR2, and applyDocxRenderResult delegates to applyPdfConvertResult.
steps: In mgmt/backend/src/r2.js, add a distinct-key builder for generated PDFs that mirrors keyForUserPhoto/keyForDonationQr. Prefer extending the layout so the object key embeds a per-generation token (Date.now()) while KEEPING the year/pdf/<docType>/ prefix intact (so the Superadmin 'Move <year> to Drive' prefix listing in storage.js still finds it). Example shape: `2026/pdf/report_en/1737000000000_Chhath-Puja-Report-2026.pdf`. Either add a new exported builder (e.g. keyForGeneratedPdf(year, docType, fileName)) or add an optional distinct/timestamp flag to keyForYear used only by the PDF sites. Do NOT change keyForYear's behavior for the consent-photo/receipt callers that rely on its current output unless you route them through the new builder deliberately. Add a code comment citing the keyForUserPhoto/keyForDonationQr precedent and the stale-CDN reason, matching the file's existing comment style. No em dashes.

In mgmt/backend/src/r2.js putToR2, allow callers to pass a cacheControl so generated PDFs get a short, revalidating Cache-Control (e.g. 'public, max-age=60, must-revalidate') written into httpMetadata.cacheControl. Keep the current default (no cacheControl / contentType only) for all existing non-PDF callers so nothing else changes. Add the new arg in a backward-compatible way (e.g. an options object or an optional 4th/5th param) and document why (belt-and-suspenders so even a fresh URL is not held long by any cache).

In mgmt/backend/src/docxTemplates.js, update the THREE generated-PDF write sites to (a) build the key with the new distinct/timestamped builder and (b) pass the generated-PDF cacheControl to putToR2: convertDocxToPdf (~L379-383), applyPdfConvertResult (~L520-524), applyPdfConvertBatchResult (~L760-764). Keep drive_path set to the SAME new key so moveOneUrl/keyFromR2Url and the move feature keep working.

In docxTemplates.js, on regeneration delete the PREVIOUS R2 object so distinct keys do not orphan-leak R2. Before the UPSERT overwrites the row, read the existing generated_files row (isFileGenerated already fetches it) to get its public_link; if it is an R2 URL for a DIFFERENT key than the new one, derive the old key via keyFromR2Url and deleteFromR2(env, oldKey) best-effort (never let a delete failure fail the generation; wrap in try/catch and log via logErrorAt like other non-fatal paths). Apply this to all three write sites (or factor a small shared helper). Only delete when the old URL is an R2 URL (isR2Url) and differs from the new key, so a Drive-hosted legacy link is never touched.
Do NOT change the recordGeneratedFile UPSERT contract: it must keep rewriting public_link AND drive_path to the NEW key/URL on every regen (verify by reading it stays intact).

Add prove-first backend tests under mgmt/backend/test/ (node:test) following existing patterns (r2-safename-unicode.test.mjs for key builders; pdf-export-report-data.test.mjs + helpers/stubs.mjs for driving handlers with an R2 stub). Cover: (1) the generated-PDF key builder embeds a distinct per-generation token so two generations of the same report (same year/docType/fileName) produce DIFFERENT keys/URLs while preserving the 2026/pdf/<docType>/ prefix (this test fails on current main where keyForYear is timestamp-free); (2) putToR2 sets httpMetadata.cacheControl to the revalidating value for generated PDFs and leaves existing non-PDF callers unchanged (assert via an R2 stub capturing the put options); (3) driving a report generation twice (e.g. via applyPdfConvertResult with an R2 stub + in-memory generated_files) writes the NEW distinct URL into generated_files.public_link/drive_path AND best-effort deletes the previous R2 object key (assert the stub recorded a delete of the old key); (4) a Drive-hosted legacy public_link is NEVER passed to deleteFromR2. Provide a small R2 stub in the test (or add makeR2 to helpers/stubs.mjs) that records put(key, bytes, opts) and delete(key) calls and backs get/list from a Map.
Run the full backend suite and confirm 0 failures and that the new tests pass. Run the render suite to confirm no regression.
acceptance_criteria: Two generations of the same report (identical year/docType/fileName) yield two DIFFERENT R2 keys and therefore two different public URLs, both under the 2026/pdf/<docType>/ prefix.

putToR2 writes a short revalidating Cache-Control (e.g. 'public, max-age=60, must-revalidate') into httpMetadata.cacheControl for generated PDFs; existing non-PDF callers (userPhoto/donationQr/popups/seo/consent) are unchanged.

After regeneration, generated_files.public_link and drive_path both point at the NEW key, and the PREVIOUS R2 object (when it was an R2 URL) is deleted best-effort; a delete failure never fails generation.
A legacy Drive public_link is never deleted (isR2Url guard).
All three PDF write sites (convertDocxToPdf, applyPdfConvertResult, applyPdfConvertBatchResult) use the distinct key + cacheControl.
Backend suite stays at 0 failures with the new prove-first tests passing; render suite stays green.
verification: cd mgmt/backend && node --test --test-reporter=spec test/*.test.mjs  # 0 fail, new tests pass
cd mgmt/server-render && npm test  # unchanged / green
git stash && cd mgmt/backend && node --test test/<new-key-test>.test.mjs ; git stash pop  # confirm the new key test FAILS on baseline (prove-first), optional sanity check
findings: Implemented on branch fix/pdf-stale-cdn-cache, commit 06a9a10. Changes: (1) r2.js: added keyForGeneratedPdf(year, docType, fileName) embedding Date.now() in the name segment while keeping the 2026/pdf/<docType>/ prefix intact; keyForYear left unchanged for non-PDF callers. (2) r2.js putToR2 now accepts an optional 5th arg cacheControl (also accepts an options object) written to httpMetadata.cacheControl; added exported const GENERATED_PDF_CACHE_CONTROL='public, max-age=60, must-revalidate'. Non-PDF callers (userPhoto/donationQr/popups/seo/consent) unchanged (contentType only). (3) docxTemplates.js: all three write sites (convertDocxToPdf ~L399, applyPdfConvertResult ~L556, applyPdfConvertBatchResult ~L797) now use keyForGeneratedPdf + pass GENERATED_PDF_CACHE_CONTROL; drive_path still set to the new key. (4) Added shared helper deletePreviousR2Object(env, existingRow, newKey, ctx): reads the pre-UPSERT row's public_link, only deletes when isR2Url and the derived old key differs from the new key, wrapped in try/catch + logErrorAt (never fails generation); convertDocxToPdf and applyPdfConvertResult now read the existing row into an outer-scoped var before the write; batch site reads it per record. (5) recordGeneratedFile UPSERT contract untouched. Tests: added makeR2 to test/helpers/stubs.mjs (records put(key,bytes,opts) + delete(key), backs get/list from a Map); new files r2-generated-pdf-key.test.mjs (distinct-key + prefix-preserved + keyForYear-unchanged + putToR2 cacheControl-for-PDF/none-for-non-PDF) and pdf-regen-stale-cdn.test.mjs (regen writes new URL to public_link AND drive_path + deletes old key; Drive legacy link never deleted). Prove-first confirmed: both new test files FAIL on baseline (git stash) and PASS after. Verification: backend node --test test/*.test.mjs = 1097 pass / 0 fail (1090 baseline + 7 new); render npm test = 203 pass / 0 fail. Did NOT push (orchestrator publishes).
